title: [FLINK-39285][table] Ignore project rel node generated by FlinkFilterJoinRule in JoinToMultiJoinRule
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

Consider the result of filter pushdown rules in the MultiJoin rule,  according [FLINK-39285](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/FLINK-39285)

## Verifying this change
